name: SHARE LOUNGE Marunouchi Tsutaya Books
nameJa: SHARE LOUNGE 丸の内 蔦屋書店
businessHours: Hours vary by day; check official site (roughly daytime to night)
description: A paid share lounge inside the Marunouchi Tsutaya bookstore by Tokyo Station with free drinks and snacks, fast Wi-Fi and power at every seat, made for laptop work.

name: Jimbocho Book Center
nameJa: 神保町ブックセンター
address: 2-3-1 Kanda-Jimbocho, Iwanami Shoten Annex, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A bookstore, cafe and coworking space lined with Iwanami books, with free Wi-Fi and power at the window counter, good for reading and laptop work.

nameJa: 5 クロスティーズコーヒー グランスタ東京

description: A hand-drip coffee stand inside Tokyo Station with counter seats that have power outlets, handy for short laptop work, though the Wi-Fi signal can be weak.

name: Bottos Ochanomizu
nameJa: 没頭作業カフェ BOTTOS 御茶ノ水駅前店
description: A dedicated work cafe by the station with ergonomic chairs, loaner monitors, free Wi-Fi and power at every seat, made for focused laptop sessions with a time-based charge.

name: Awajizaka Coffee Ochanomizu
nameJa: 淡路坂珈琲 お茶の水店
address: 2-9 Kanda-Awajicho, Under the JR Kobaibashi elevated tracks No.4, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A natural wood cafe under the train tracks with a riverside terrace, free Wi-Fi and power at every seat, good for laptop work.

name: Cafe Ohana
description: A quiet hideaway cafe on an upper floor in Ginza with free Wi-Fi, power outlets and a nomad plan with refillable coffee, good for laptop work.

name: KNAG
description: A community cafe with high ceilings in the Kabutocho finance district, with free Wi-Fi and power at some seats, good for laptop work.

name: Cafe & Bar Moutiers
nameJa: カフェ&バー ムーティエ
description: A calm basement cafe and bar in Ginza with free Wi-Fi and power, open from afternoon until late, good for evening laptop work.

name: SHARE LOUNGE Roppongi Tsutaya Books

description: A paid share lounge on the second floor of Roppongi Tsutaya with free drinks and snacks, fast Wi-Fi and power at every seat, very calm for focused laptop work.

name: Cafeteria S Omotesando
nameJa: カフェテリア S 表参道
address: 3-5-40 Kita-Aoyama, PRYME CUBE Omotesando 1F, Minato-ku, Tokyo

name: Eric Rose
description: A Hawaiian-style specialty coffee cafe near Omotesando with free Wi-Fi and power at the counter seats, good for a work session.

name: Kohii Chakan Shu Roppongi
nameJa: 珈琲茶館 集 六本木店
description: A calm retro kissaten (a traditional Japanese coffee house) with classical music and siphon coffee, free Wi-Fi and power at the table seats, good for quiet laptop work.

description: A paid share lounge on the 11th floor of the Tsutaya bookstore with city views, high-speed Wi-Fi, power and loaner monitors, made for laptop work.

description: A paid share lounge on the second floor of the Daikanyama T-SITE bookstore complex with free drinks, high-speed Wi-Fi and power, quiet for laptop work.

name: Cha Cafe Do
description: A calm cafe serving siphon coffee and Taiwanese tea with free Wi-Fi and power at the large central tables, good for laptop work.

name: niko and ... TOKYO
description: A lifestyle-store cafe near Harajuku with free Wi-Fi and power at the central table, handy for laptop work, though it can get busy.

name: Cozy Style Coffee
nameJa: コージースタイルコーヒー
description: A warm, architect-run coffee shop lined with design books, with free Wi-Fi and power at most seats and a quiet upstairs floor good for laptop work.

description: A bright, health-focused cafe near Ochanomizu with free Wi-Fi and power at the counter and some tables, good for daytime laptop work.

description: A paid share lounge near Ikebukuro's west exit with free drinks and snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi, power and a book library, made for laptop work.
